scope: Uncommitted integration worktree UI changes. React DOM and Control runtime contract tests use synthetic records and mock services; this record does not claim native picker, model execution, or installed-app verification.
userPaths: Sidebar + is always 新增空间 and calls native selectAndRegister. A canceled folder picker keeps the selected conversation; only a committed selection opens a new-task draft.
Every registered workspace remains visible, including empty workspaces. Each conversation appears only under its server-owned workspaceId; legacy null/missing ownership remains in 无工作空间.
Choosing an existing workspace uses activate without replacing the Control runtime. 取消选择工作空间 clears active selection without removing registry entries or rewriting conversation ownership.
Selecting a saved conversation follows its workspaceId for active filesystem context. A workspace activation failure is visible and gates current-conversation send and file actions.

Ordinary first sends, Assistant creation, Skill trials/execution, Skill schedule preparation, and Office group conversations carry the captured active workspaceId. Assistant and Office history lookup do not adopt conversations from another workspace.

Late new-conversation selection callbacks do not select their result after the user changes workspace. Skill operation state is scoped by workspace, and old preparation callbacks cannot dispatch after a workspace switch.

commandWorkspaceRegression.change: Updated the Control sidebar fixture to include its registered workspaceId and the conversation's matching persisted owner. Kept all conversation-chrome and archive assertions and added the workspace group ID check.

compatibilityAudit.change: Both readers accept only the additional optional workspaceId field and validate it through the shared contract parser. Unknown keys remain rejected. Rollback responses must preserve workspaceId.
compatibilityAudit.legacy: Missing workspaceId normalizes to null; active native selection is never substituted as ownership.
compatibilityAudit.internalDefinitionThreads: Expert/Workflow definition markers remain unbound metadata records. Runtime forks inherit ownership from their parent on the server.

finalChecks.typecheck: Workspace changes have no remaining TypeScript diagnostics. The concurrent final check reported one error in the separate pagination task's TranscriptWindowControls.tsx:60; that task and root coordinator were notified.
finalChecks.fullUiBuildAndInstalledApp: Owned by the root coordinator after both concurrent UI tasks are ready.
